text_block_list.text: There was something I wanted to make, so I decided to borrow the academy's kitchen for a bit, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let's get started!!
Are you all reaaady!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Sensei!
I look forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Today's challenge is...
Named 'Survive on Limited Ingredients!
A 1-Week Survival Life!'!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Zombies outside the academy...
Our food supply is limited.
How should we spend our time elegantly in a situation like this?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The tension is through the roof!
As a princess, one must acquire the art of surviving gracefully in any situation!

"...Are they playing pretend?
For a scenario where they're surrounded by zombies,
they seem to be having a lot of fun."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first, let us head to the
academy's fields to search for ingredients...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My goodness...! Having to leave the building so suddenly—this really is an emergency!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Eating is living, after all!
When your stomach's empty, that's already a full-blown emergency!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You have a point...!
Understood, please leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, I shall blow away
mere zombies with a single blow!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Perfect timing! Hey, hey,
I need you to play the zombie!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"My, my! How wonderful.
A lone zombie infiltrating the school...!
Please, do come and chase after us!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't worry!
It's not like I'm going to beat you up,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, here we go!
Ready, set... GO!

Before I even knew what was happening,
I had been turned into a zombie...
For now, I decided to follow after them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
From here to here are the veggies I grew,
so feel free to pick some~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is so juicy and fresh!
I almost want to take a bite out of it whole.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Those look delicious too, but gotta hold back☆
Alright, let's get harvesting~!

The two were completely absorbed in harvesting.
Though worn out after running at full tilt—

"As a zombie,
what should I do here?"
choice_data_list: Show some guts and chase after them

text_block_list.text: Letting out a groaning moan like a zombie from a video game, I started running toward the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaa!? Y-You scared me!
Wait, you caught up already!?
Trainer-san, you're amazing."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Akebono, step back, please!
That person is a zombie!
Take this, you fiend-desu-wa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A huge tomato got stuffed in your mouth!!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Mr. Zombie must be
super hungry too!
Alright, I'm gonna feed you a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The other veggies are super delicious too,
so I'm sure even Mr. Zombie would love them—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You must not!
Our food supplies are limited, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!
Ugh... It makes me so sad that
I can't fill your tummy up~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I must face this harsh reality!
Now, while it's busy chewing,
let us beat it—no, make our escape!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's sad, but...
Goodbye, Mr. Zombie!!

The two quickly vanished into the distance.
Though I was left all alone in the field, stuck in a two-handed zombie pose—

Hishi Akebono seemed to have learned something
from my sheer desperation, so I decided
to call it a win.

"I decided to appear before the two of them
with a lively vigor unbefitting a zombie."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait!?
Trainer, you're a zombie, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I feel completely full of energy!
Did I come back to life or something!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, you must not be deceived!
Surely that is... a Super Zombie!
A powered-up zombie!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? How did you power up like that!?
Did you eat a ton of food or something!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It gave you more energy than eating my cooking!?
What what what!? What kind of dish was it!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Look out!
You must not approach alone!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"There's no other way now...!
Akebono-san, let's join forces
and pin that zombie down!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, all right!
I'll catch them and squeeze out every detail of what they ate!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose to any zombies!
I'll show 'em my chanko power!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here it comes—!!
Lifted with ease, the pitiful zombie was thoroughly defeated by the cheerful, laughing Umamusume.
